name: Steward ACS — LLM usage
description: Token usage, latency, errors, and audit outcomes for Acs.LLM (memory/skill auditor). Filter action==llm_call. Dataset: steward_logs.

query.apl:
['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call"
| count

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call" and ['status'] == "ok"
| count

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call" and ['status'] == "error"
| count

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call" and ['status'] in ("ok", "error")
| summarize ok=countif(['status'] == "ok"), n=count()
| extend rate = iff(n == 0, 0.0, 100.0 * ok / n)
| project rate

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call"
| summarize c=count() by bin(_time, 15m), status

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call" and isnotnull(['tokens_in'])
| summarize t=sum(todouble(['tokens_in']))
| project t

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call" and isnotnull(['tokens_out'])
| summarize t=sum(todouble(['tokens_out']))
| project t

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call" and ['status'] == "ok" and isnotnull(['tokens_in'])
| summarize t=avg(todouble(['tokens_in']))
| project t

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call" and ['status'] == "ok" and isnotnull(['tokens_out'])
| summarize t=avg(todouble(['tokens_out']))
| project t

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call" and ['status'] == "ok"
| summarize tokens_in=sum(todouble(['tokens_in'])), tokens_out=sum(todouble(['tokens_out'])) by bin(_time, 15m)

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call" and ['status'] == "ok"
| summarize calls=count(), tokens_in=sum(todouble(['tokens_in'])), tokens_out=sum(todouble(['tokens_out'])), avg_in=avg(todouble(['tokens_in'])), avg_out=avg(todouble(['tokens_out'])), avg_prompt_chars=avg(todouble(['prompt_chars'])) by call_type, audience
| order by tokens_in desc
| limit 20

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call" and ['status'] == "ok" and isnotnull(['tokens_in'])
| summarize n=count(), avg_prompt_chars=avg(todouble(['prompt_chars'])), avg_tokens_in=avg(todouble(['tokens_in'])), avg_tokens_out=avg(todouble(['tokens_out'])) by call_type, model
| order by avg_tokens_in desc
| limit 20

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call" and isnotnull(['latency_ms'])
| summarize t=avg(todouble(['latency_ms']))
| project t

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call" and isnotnull(['latency_ms'])
| summarize t=percentile(todouble(['latency_ms']), 95)
| project t

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call" and isnotnull(['latency_ms'])
| summarize p50=percentile(todouble(['latency_ms']), 50), p95=percentile(todouble(['latency_ms']), 95) by bin(_time, 15m)

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call" and isnotnull(['latency_ms'])
| summarize calls=count(), ok=countif(['status'] == "ok"), avg_ms=avg(todouble(['latency_ms'])), p95_ms=percentile(todouble(['latency_ms']), 95) by provider, model, call_type
| order by calls desc
| limit 20

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call" and isnotnull(['latency_ms'])
| summarize calls=count(), ok=countif(['status'] == "ok"), avg_ms=avg(todouble(['latency_ms'])), p50_ms=percentile(todouble(['latency_ms']), 50), p95_ms=percentile(todouble(['latency_ms']), 95) by call_type
| order by calls desc
| limit 20

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call" and isnotnull(['latency_ms'])
| summarize p95=percentile(todouble(['latency_ms']), 95) by bin(_time, 15m), call_type

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call"
| summarize c=count() by bin(_time, 15m), call_type

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call" and ['status'] == "ok" and isnotnull(['recommendation'])
| summarize n=count(), avg_quality=avg(todouble(['quality_score'])) by call_type, recommendation, audience
| order by n desc
| limit 25

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call"
| summarize calls=count(), ok=countif(['status'] == "ok"), err=countif(['status'] == "error"), tokens_in=sum(todouble(['tokens_in'])), tokens_out=sum(todouble(['tokens_out'])) by provider, model, call_type
| order by calls desc
| limit 25

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call" and ['status'] == "error" and isnotnull(['error_type'])
| summarize c=count() by bin(_time, 15m), error_type

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call" and ['status'] == "error"
| summarize n=count(), avg_latency_ms=avg(todouble(['latency_ms'])) by error_type, provider, call_type
| order by n desc
| limit 30

['__LOGS_DATASET__']
| where ['action'] == "llm_call" and ['status'] == "error"
| project _time, error_type, provider, model, call_type, audience, latency_ms, message
| order by _time desc
| limit 40
